findings.author_position: Actual R4 implementation receipt explicitly declares this post-freeze finding blocking; frozen work remains unchanged.
findings.impact: The exact-caller preflight can invoke substituted behavior and accept a function whose live default differs from pinned source before attempt/native admission.
findings.issue: validate_defaults uses ordinary tuple/dict equality on live defaults. A substituted object can run __eq__ and compare equal to the required None default.
findings.proof: data_value, validate_defaults, validate_definitions and full validate_prepared ASTs remain identical to R3. Retained R3 canonical _cpu_window reproduction passes full validate_prepared with a wrong default and records the equality hook. Fresh exact R4 predicate AST control reproduces acceptance and one NoneType equality-hook call.
findings.repair: Separate successor: strict type/identity-safe recursive positional and keyword-default validation. Reject unknown objects before equality, iteration, hashing or descriptor hooks; preserve legitimate pinned defaults.
findings.required_regressions: Real pinned WindowsOwnedProcess._cpu_window hostile default must be refused by full validate_prepared with zero hostile hook calls; cover keyword defaults/nested approved containers and preserve current88IDs/original28ASTs.
